content: You are a senior software engineer helping refactor a Python web application.

I need to refactor our user authentication module. It's grown to over 2000 lines and handles login, registration, password reset, OAuth, API keys, and session management all in one file. Can you help break it down?
I'll analyze the auth module and propose splitting into login, registration, password reset, oauth, api_keys, and middleware packages.

name: file_read
content: # auth.py - monolithic authentication module (login, register, oauth, api keys, middleware)... [truncated for demo]
